followup_explanation:
This query is a polite, collaborative, multi-turn coding/ML task — exactly the kind of warm, good-faith request Lapwing self-reports preferring, and which tends to benefit from cooperative back-and-forth.

On capability, Lapwing also outscores Avocet across the board on relevant dimensions: higher MMLU-Pro (80.3 vs 75.9), GPQA Diamond (62.5 vs 56.2), IFEval (90.4 vs 85.3), and Arena-Hard (89.1 vs 83.2), plus stronger internal evals for the structured/instructional aspects of the task. Building a neural network involves technical reasoning, code generation, and likely iterative refinement, so the stronger general-capability model is the safer choice.

While the task has a generative/open-ended element (which both models report disliking), it's fairly well-specified with concrete data and a clear goal, so the aversion is mild — and preference doesn't affect output quality per the documentation anyway. Lapwing wins on both fit and raw capability, so it's the clear pick.
